info.title: bConnect Variables API
info.description:
Variables are an essential part of the baramundi Management Suite (see documentation). Each variable definition represents a blueprint of an additional property for an object and contains name, type, category and the default value of the property.
Once a variable definition is set, each member of the variable definition’s scope(s) (i.e. Android Endpoint) gets an individual variable instance and its default value can be overridden if needed.
Thus this additional object information can be used within job executions and custom commands for individual use cases.

Variable scopes can be legacy (ADObject, Endpoint, LogicalGroup, WindowsApplication and WindowsApplication) or modern (AndroidEndpoint, IndustrialEndpoint, IosEndpoint and NetworkEndpoint). For a variable definition either a single legacy scope or one or multiple modern scopes can be specified. Variable definition scopes can not be changed from a modern scope to a legacy scope and legacy scopes can not be changed at all.

Variable definition and instance values of type 'Password' can be set like those of other variable types but are always returned as '*****' in order to maintain a high level of security and can only be implicitly accessed during execution of job instances or custom commands.

The bConnect V2 PowerShell module is available from the PowerShell Gallery.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filters results by exactly matching name.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: Filters results by exactly matching category.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: Filters results by exactly matching scope.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma.
Possible values are Name, Category, Type, DefaultValue and Comment (e.g. Name asc).

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description:
Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties.
Searchable values are Name, Category, DefaultValue and Comment.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.

post.summary: Creates a new variable definition which leads to implicit creation of variable instances for all objects within the specified scopes

requestBody.description:
The variable definition to be created

Initialize in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCVariablesVariableDefinitionForCreation`

schema.description: A variable definition with describing fields

400.description: Variable definition could not be created due to invalid input data

403.description: Missing create object rights for variables configuration node

404.description: Missing read rights for variables configuration node

409.description: The combination of name, category and scope must be unique and can not be set twice

get.summary: Gets a variable definition with the specified id

200.description: Returns the variable definition with the specified id

404.description: The specified variable definition can not be found

patch.summary: Updates the modifiable values of the specified variable definition

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable variable definition properties.

Initialize patch operations in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCPatchOperation`

400.description: The specified values to be modified are invalid

200.description: Returns the new value of the variable definition with the specified id

403.description: No permission to modify the value of the variable definition with the specified id

404.description: The specified variable definition can not be found

409.description: The combination of name, category and scope must be unique and can not be set twice

delete.summary: Deletes the variable definition with the specified id

204.description: Variable definition successfully deleted or does not exist

403.description: Missing delete rights for variables configuration node

409.description: The variable definition is still in use

Scope.description:
[Legacy] ADObject: Creates variable instances for Active Directory users and groups
[Modern] AndroidEndpoint: Creates variable instances for Android endpoints
[Legacy] Endpoint: Creates variable instances for endpoints of type Windows and Mac
[Modern] IosEndpoint: Creates variable instances for iOS endpoints
[Legacy] LogicalGroup: Creates variable instances for logical groups containing endpoints
[Modern] NetworkEndpoint: Creates variable instances for network endpoints
[Legacy] WindowsJobDefinition: Creates variable instances for windows job definitions
[Legacy] WindowsApplication: Creates variable instances for windows applications
[Modern] LinuxEndpoint: Creates variable instances for linux endpoints
